Evidence & scope

Distinct SWE-Atlas primary paper work or named benchmark family. Complete primary-text and declared selected-visual/creator-release scopes were actually read independently, and all16 bounded assertions carry exact author, source-verifier and adversarial AI source-content reviews. Paper v1, current v1.1 repository and the modified AA QnA release remain distinct. AA cards, task components and release variants do not add independent families. No experiment reproduction, independent upstream rights clearance, withheld proprietary manual review or unsubstantiated supplier contribution is implied. Core inventory eligibility/disposition freeze remains separate.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

SWE Atlas: Benchmarking Coding Agents Beyond Issue Resolution · documents: SWE Atlas describes professional software engineers creating tasks and reference solutions, review by an independent quality-control team, and independent audits by three trusted experts of instructions, verification and rubrics.

Permanent record ID: candidate.normal18.swe-atlas.expert-construction-and-qa

  • Original author-stage note: Actual new author-only source-content proposal. Distinct source-verifier/adversarial exact-digest reviews and coordinator admission are pending. No replication, independently adjudicated rights, commercial supplier credit, or deep credit is implied.
  • Rubrics marked invalid, over-prescriptive or ambiguous by at least two of the three experts are filtered.
  • This records the benchmark authors' quality-control procedure; reviewer identities, overlap and each task's review artifacts were not independently audited in this author phase.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

SWE Atlas: Benchmarking Coding Agents Beyond Issue Resolution · documents: The paper compares human and three model judges on 200 rubric gradings of responses from Opus 4.5 and GPT-5, then reports selecting Opus 4.5 as the judge for its runs.

Permanent record ID: candidate.normal18.swe-atlas.grader-validation-scopes

  • Original author-stage note: Actual new author-only source-content proposal. Distinct source-verifier/adversarial exact-digest reviews and coordinator admission are pending. No replication, independently adjudicated rights, commercial supplier credit, or deep credit is implied.
  • Separate reported studies cover 1,306 rubric-level model judgments and repeated grading of 30 Q&A responses across five runs, totaling 510 rubric evaluations.
  • These are distinct sampled validation scopes; 200 is not a human-rater headcount or evidence of independent human grading of every benchmark response. The author did not reproduce the agreement studies.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

SWE Atlas: Benchmarking Coding Agents Beyond Issue Resolution · documents: SWE Atlas v1 distinguishes Pass@3, meaning any successful trial, Pass@1, meaning average per-trial success, and Pass3, meaning all three trials succeed.

Permanent record ID: candidate.normal18.swe-atlas.three-trial-metric-definitions

  • Original author-stage note: Actual new author-only source-content proposal. Distinct source-verifier/adversarial exact-digest reviews and coordinator admission are pending. No replication, independently adjudicated rights, commercial supplier credit, or deep credit is implied.
  • Table 1 describes three-trial averaging and trial-level Wilson confidence intervals.
  • The author did not reproduce the statistics, treat trials as independently established comparable samples or interchange the three metrics.
